standard_prerequisites.name: Point-like spaces

core_obligations: (1) implies (2): the fibre-product diagram with finite separable residue field extensions shows the top arrows are etale quasi-compact with finite fibres, so |w x_X w'| is finite.
(2) implies (3): u x_X u is finite; its projections factor as a monomorphism base change composed with an etale base change; conclude u x_X u -> u is quasi-compact etale via the schemes lemma.
(3) implies (4): X' = Spec(k)/R is an algebraic space; the quotient map X' -> X is a monomorphism; point-like spaces identifies X' = Spec(k').
(4) implies (1): u -> U -> X factors through Spec(k) -> X; k(u)/k is finite separable; hence u x_X u = u x_{Spec(k)} u is finite.
proof_roadmap: Diagram chase for (1)-(2); monomorphism decomposition for (2)-(3); quotient presentation for (3)-(4); factorization finish for (4)-(1).
difficulty_reason: A four-direction equivalence of point conditions, each direction with its own diagram or quotient argument; no direction is a routine citation.
